_meta.purpose: PORTABLE n-of-1 protocol templates: ready designs for self-experiments with the feasibility already computed. There are no personal data; the owner's own experiments live in profile/experiments.json.
_meta.how_to_use: python3 src/ingest/nof1.py register --id <your_id> --hypothesis ... --metric ... --blocks ... --phase-days ... — take the parameters from the template. Registration BEFORE the collection of data begins.
_meta.design_rule: Significance is limited by the number of BLOCKS, not by the number of days: when the labels of n blocks (equally split between A and B) are permuted, the minimum achievable one-sided p equals 1/C(n, n/2). Hence: 4 blocks → 0.167 (significance is impossible), 6 → 0.050, 8 → 0.014, 10 → 0.004. Lengthening the phases is pointless — what has to grow is the NUMBER of blocks.
_meta.why_blocks_not_days: The daily series of sleep and stress are autocorrelated: neighbouring nights are alike, so 14 days of a phase do not give 14 independent observations. A test by days systematically underestimates p (on the project's real data — by a factor of several), that is, it manufactures confidence where there is none.
common_pitfalls: changing the protocol after having looked at the data — that turns a test into a fit; start a new experiment instead
several 'primary' metrics — multiplicity; there is exactly one primary metric, the rest are exploratory
a rigid ABAB — vulnerable to trend and season; the order of the blocks is randomised
no washout — carry-over of the effect of the previous phase (caffeine: days; drugs: weeks)
a comparison across the boundary of a change of device or of measurement method

title.en: Moving caffeine to the first half of the day
title.ru: Перенос кофеина на первую половину дня

hypothesis.en: giving up caffeine after 12:00 increases deep sleep
hypothesis.ru: отказ от кофеина после 12:00 увеличивает глубокий сон

note.en: The half-life of caffeine is 4–6 h, longer in slow metabolisers — 3 days of washout cover the carry-over. Genetics (CYP1A2) sets the plausibility of the hypothesis but does not replace the measurement.
note.ru: Период полувыведения кофеина 4–6 ч, у медленных метаболизаторов дольше — 3 дня washout закрывают перенос. Генетика (CYP1A2) задаёт правдоподобие гипотезы, но не заменяет измерение.

title.ru: Более раннее время отхода ко сну

hypothesis.en: going to bed 45 minutes earlier than usual increases deep sleep
hypothesis.ru: отбой на 45 минут раньше обычного увеличивает глубокий сон

note.en: The only lever that worked monotonically in the project's retrospective; a prospective test is needed precisely because a retrospective does not confirm the hypothesis but only proposes it.
note.ru: Единственный рычаг, монотонно работавший в ретроспективе проекта; проспективная проверка нужна именно потому, что ретроспектива гипотезу не подтверждает, а только предлагает.

hypothesis.en: a dinner with a low share of fast carbohydrates lowers night-time stress
hypothesis.ru: ужин с низкой долей быстрых углеводов снижает ночной стресс

note.en: Short phases are admissible: the effect of dinner shows up the same night. More blocks at the same duration — a stricter test.
note.ru: Короткие фазы допустимы: эффект ужина проявляется в ту же ночь. Больше блоков при той же длительности — строже тест.

hypothesis.en: giving up alcohol at the weekend removes the dip in deep sleep
hypothesis.ru: отказ от алкоголя в выходные убирает провал глубокого сна

note.en: The phase is a multiple of a week deliberately: the effect is tied to the day of the week, and with a non-multiple length the blocks would contain different numbers of weekend days and there would be nothing to compare.
note.ru: Фаза кратна неделе намеренно: эффект привязан к дню недели, при некратной длительности блоки будут содержать разное число выходных и сравнивать будет нечего.
